node.title: Rank-eleven bare rich atlas does not force a factor presentation
node.closure: two coprime rich locator blocks give full-span no-core polynomial atlases outside every two-by-five product locus
node.statement: The bare rank-eleven terminal dim C'=10, at least 16384884 distinct spanning dimension-two/three containers, and at least 38385 actual common zeros per container does not imply C'=span(PB) with dimensions 2 x 5, even after excluding a global common zero. Put H=38385,d=H+4,D=2H+4. Two coprime split H-root locators times generic five-spaces produce a 10H-dimensional family of no-core ten-spaces and enough rich containers. All 2 x 5 product loci have dimension at most 5D-25=10H-5. Exact Gaussian bounds show the countermodels exist over official-size finite fields and remain below degree K. This fences only the bare atlas inference; chronology-aware synchronization is not refuted.
